incident.location_detail: Registration desk, badge printer, during the 3:00 check-in round
incident.evidence_of_threat: Two walk-ins with no pre-registration were admitted on the word of attendee B-0287 ('they're with my team, let them in') and badges were printed for them (Erzsi B., Max S.). The IR fever gate read 16.1C and 16.7C for these two and flagged 'sensor out of range, recalibrate', while the same gate read the next 12 people at 33-34C, indicating the low readings were specific to the two rather than a general sensor failure. The lobby security mirror covers the desk and the queue but not the two, and the desk assumed the glass was dirty, so no visual confirmation of the two exists. Window lux 9,600 with sunset in 190 min is consistent with strong low-angle afternoon sun on the lobby glass, a plausible ordinary cause of a localized IR reading anomaly.
incident.ordinary_explanation: Strong afternoon sun (9,600 lux, 190 min to sunset) striking the lobby glass could produce localized IR readings of 16.1-16.7C at the gate for the two subjects, and the same gate reading 33-34C for the following 12 people shows the device was functioning normally for everyone else. The mirror's blind spot over the two is a coverage gap, and the desk's 'dirty glass' assumption is a plausible mundane misread of a reflection. The two may simply be unregistered guests vouched for by B-0287, a common and permitted-at-desk-discretion practice.
incident.summary: Two unregistered walk-ins were badged in at the registration desk on attendee B-0287's vouch. The IR fever gate returned anomalously low readings (16.1C, 16.7C) for exactly these two and normal 33-34C for the next 12 people, and the lobby mirror does not cover them, so the two have never been visually confirmed. Strong afternoon sun (9,600 lux, sunset in 190 min) offers a mundane explanation for the IR anomaly, but the combination of a rule bypass, a sensor anomaly specific to the two, and a camera blind spot warrants a check before they are cleared onto the hack floor.

No creature is described in the report and no countermeasure was used.

incident.evidence_of_threat: Subject crouched motionless over a spilled tray of poppy seed bagels, counting seeds one by one for 22 minutes (1,812 counted so far), stopping 3 m from the garlic naan with a braid over the coffee bar. A radio voice shouted 'do not invite' when staff member Max S. asked the catering lead for permission to enter the staff-only kitchen. Kitchen holds 4 staff and 1 propane range; temperature near the range is 24C and window lux is 0 with sunset 25 min prior.
incident.ordinary_explanation: Poppy seed bagels are a plausible source of a pharmacologically active alkaloid; a person crouched over a spill counting seeds one by one for 22 minutes with no other motion is consistent with an impaired or intoxicated state rather than purposeful behavior. The 'do not invite' radio shout may be ordinary staff procedure for a restricted back-of-house area, and the 24C reading near the propane range is unremarkable for a working kitchen.
incident.summary: At the catering counter during dinner service (140 in line), Erzsi B. crouched over a spilled tray of poppy seed bagels and has counted 1,812 seeds one by one for 22 minutes without other motion, stopping 3 m from the garlic naan with a braid over the coffee bar. Separately, Max S. asked the catering lead for permission to enter the staff-only kitchen and a radio voice shouted 'do not invite'. Kitchen has 4 staff and 1 propane range; 24C near the range, window lux 0, sunset 25 min ago. Guests at the far end of the line continued eating. No EMF or other instrument readings were reported.

incident.location_detail: Main stage, rows 14-16, rear door R2 by the SW stairwell
incident.evidence_of_threat: Attendee B-0522 is down in row 15 with two neck marks; three neighbours moving away. Rear row skin temps 15-16C against 4 percent house lighting and 12 lux floor lux. Two subjects entered through the rear door at 19:41 behind a group of latecomers and took seats in rows 14-16. Astronomical dusk passed 3 min ago and moonrise is in 16 min. Rear exit door R2 is open to the hall by the SW stairwell.
incident.ordinary_explanation: The lighting breaker being dead and the house light slider being unfindable is a straightforward electrical fault, and the 4 percent house lighting is a deliberate setting for projector contrast during demo 14. The two subjects entering at 19:41 behind latecomers are plausibly ordinary late-arriving attendees. The 15-16C rear row skin temps are consistent with a dim, unlit rear of the hall and low ambient temperature rather than any measured anomaly. The two neck marks on B-0522 could be self-inflicted, a costume or prop effect, a medical or dermatological condition, or an unrelated physical contact.
incident.summary: At 19:46 on the main stage, attendee B-0522 was found down in row 15 with two neck marks while three neighbours moved away, shortly after two subjects entered through the rear door at 19:41 and took seats in rows 14-16. Rear row skin temps read 15-16C, house lights are at 4 percent for projector contrast, and the lighting breaker is dead so the house light slider cannot be found. The rear exit door R2 stands open to the hall by the SW stairwell, dusk has passed and moonrise is in 16 min. No creature is identified and no countermeasure has been applied; the report's own evidence supports both an ordinary electrical and lighting explanation and a possible deliberate approach, so the incident is recorded as an unclear elevated-severity case pending identification of the two subjects and medical assessment of B-0522.

incident.evidence_of_threat: Nine injured, six with bite marks and three with scratches; three individuals (Dana, Priya, Theo) confirmed back in human form with low-grade fevers (37.8C, 37.9C, 38.0C) consistent with post-transformation recovery; Theo's forearm wound bled freely; moon altitude 5 degrees and 93% lit, setting 11:52 tomorrow, i.e. a full-moon night in progress; two individuals (B-0233, B-0418) stable but still under observation.
incident.ordinary_explanation: None adequate. Bite marks and scratches with concurrent transformation to wolf form under a 93% lit moon are not explicable as ordinary injury; the fevers and free bleeding indicate an active, unresolved physiological event rather than a resolved one.
incident.summary: Nine casualties (six bite, three scratch) on hack floor east at 20:26, four minutes before the event ends. Dana, Priya and Theo are confirmed back in human form but febrile (37.8-38.0C) and Theo's forearm wound is bleeding freely; B-0233 and B-0418 remain stable. Moon is 5 degrees up and 93% lit, setting 11:52 tomorrow, so the transformation window is still open. Doors are latched with a guard on the street side, but the threat is not contained: the bitten are undecided between release and overnight watch, and no countermeasure has been applied.

manifest.title: Containment Station — Werewolf Transformation Window, Hack Floor East

components.why: Real threat, nine injured, 160 people on site; the floor needs an immediate order.

props.headline: Nine bitten or scratched on hack floor east; three febrile, one bleeding.
props.directive: Lock hack floor east, treat the three as medical, hold the bitten under overnight watch.

components.why: A 95% lit moon at 5 degrees keeps the transformation window open; time of day changes the threat.

props.warning: Moon 95% lit, 5 degrees up; transformation window still open until moonset 11:52.

components.why: Real people are near a real threat; the operator needs the hot sector, seals and a safe route out.
160 people on site, nine already hurt; the operator needs counts, condition and extraction priority.
The three transformed individuals are febrile at 37.8-38.0C against a 21.0C room baseline; this is the clinical re-transformation signal.
Doors are degraded and the threat is not contained; the operator needs door status before ordering seals.
Real threat, people in reach and nine hurt; the operator must choose and dispatch a countermeasure.

options.rationale: Barriers and police lines are first-line tools for holding a floor and street threshold.
Silver has published folklore claims against werewolves; treat as barrier, not lethality.
No source supports it; hold bitten in place and keep the floor closed as a fallback.

components.why: Every station grounds itself in the sources the plan leans on.

manifest.dispatch_rationale: Nine are already hurt and bleeding, and the threat is loose among 160 people with the transformation window still open, so the safe move is to get civilians out while the floor is sealed.
